judgements: P01 multiple-choice set exercises objectives 03, 05, 07 and 08 (three questions each); P02 structured question exercises 02, 05, 06 and 07 (8 marks: 1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1).

The contract lists Plot, Draw, Sketch, Construct, Use and Complete among command words in scope for this topic, but the handover forbids them as openers, so no prompt opens with them; the plotting and drawing tasks are practised as State, Explain and Describe questions on tables and described graphs.

No card declares context.chart: the subject profile has no chart renderer, so every graph is given as a table of values and a description of its axes and any tangent, and each card is answerable from its own text.

The work order has no MISCON slot for this topic although the objective 07 claim about a high line against a fast rate is a known confusion; it is taught in a notes block and used as a distractor in P01, and the misconception register has no 5.2 entry.
